title: Law to test street barriers that slow traffic in each borough
summary: This bill would require the Department of Transportation to run two 2-year pilot programs, one installing boom barriers and one installing diagonal traffic diverters, with at least one device placed in a neighborhood in each borough. The department must consult transportation experts and local community boards on locations, keep the areas separate, and allow access for emergency, delivery, sanitation and resident vehicles. It must also study effects on crashes, injuries, noise, traffic and emissions, and report findings, device counts and locations to the mayor and Council within six months of each pilot's end.
